# Travis Lenkner appears on Non-Billable Podcast to talk about law firm equity


- Law firm equity


August 6, 2025


-
-
-
-


[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) , Chief Development Officer at Burford Capital, joins *The Non-Billable Podcast* to discuss why private equity and other external investors are increasingly interested in law firms. He also shares Burford’s approach to minority investments and the evolving dynamics in the UK and US legal markets.
